name: sound_check
description: Prove the machine's audio actually works: list the microphones and speakers the operating system reports as usable, measure a speaker test tone, show a live microphone input meter and report the peak it heard, and read back the output volume after setting it. A muted microphone and a level slider at zero both pass every automated probe on silence, so the only real proof is a person speaking - and the meter says what it heard instead of assuming.

operation.description: One of: devices | tone | meter | volume | diagnosis. Defaults to devices.

kind.description: Device kind for devices: input | output | all. Defaults to all.

device.description: Device name for tone, meter or volume. Defaults to the selected device.

volume.description: Volume percentage 0-100 for the volume operation.

seconds.description: How long the meter listens. Defaults to 3, capped at 20.

frequency.description: Test-tone frequency in Hz. Defaults to 440.

author: Stella
notes: Backends: sounddevice for devices and metering, pycaw/AppleScript/pactl/amixer for volume, ffplay/numpy for the test tone. Each is probed per call and named when missing.
